_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, front ranks on the y=300 line, cavalry centres at y -180), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,723). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet. Uids 8 and 9's overlap exemptions and uid 3's facing_flutter exemption are gone: since #1880 each passes the gating scan, and on dense 2-tick FULL dumps (every exemption removed, Windows) each passes on every one of seeds 0 to 4 on e57be4c6, where 9f9bddee reads, on seeds 0 to 4, pass, 0.56, pass, pass, pass for uid 8 and 3.24, pass, pass, pass, pass for uid 9 against 5.0, and pass, pass, pass, pass, 4.00 for uid 3 against 3. Measured 2026-10-31 on the tree later committed as e57be4c6; seed 0 re-checked on e57be4c6 2026-11-01. The square casualty close-up moves this clip from tick 988 on every one of seeds 0 to 4 (6d2c54a8 against the merge-base b055ef7f; unchanged by the merge of d0272c6d). Three exemptions went stale and are gone: overlap uid 6, path_crossing uid 3 and facing_flutter uid 4 each pass on all five seeds on dense 2-tick FULL dumps with every exemption removed, on c078f6cd and on b055ef7f alike (uid 6 overlap 17.07 wu against 2.25; uid 3 path_crossing 0.0 against 0.15; uid 4 facing_flutter 0, 0, 0, 1, 0 here and 1, 0, 0, 1, 0 on b055ef7f, against 3). Uid 3 is exempted for facing_flutter instead (see that reason). Measured 2026-11-03, Windows.

shape_residual.reason: Uid 3 is tracked in #1804 (its mounts end the charge cycle far off their slots) and uid 4 in #1841 (the caracoling cavalry's heading reversals). Uid 3's men are off their slots for the rest of the clip on both trees, its residual climbing from 94 wu at tick 1100 to 255 at 1300 on main 2c2955cc and from 86 to 162 on branch ed307f22. Uid 4's residual climbs after its heading reverses: on main, on the clip seed, it turns about 173 degrees between ticks 1120 and 1140 and its residual climbs from 6.3 wu then to 33.6 at tick 1300; on branch ed307f22, with flank and rear contact at the defender's edge (#1845), it reverses at ticks 1160 and 1180 and climbs from 9.7 to 56.3. Measured 2026-10-22 with 2-tick samples from tick 2 on the clip seed and perturbed seeds 1 to 4 against the 30 wu threshold, each verdict the largest residual among the samples the analyzer judges (it leaves out samples in a reshape's transit window): uid 3 fails on all five on both trees (main 250.8 to 259.9, branch ed307f22 162.5 to 221.9); uid 4 fails on main on the clip seed (31.3, at tick 1292: the 33.6 at tick 1300 falls in a transit window), seed 1 (34.3) and seed 4 (52.2), and on branch ed307f22 on all five (clip seed 56.3, seed 1 56.8, seed 2 61.3, seed 3 57.0, seed 4 66.1).

overlap.reason: Measured 2026-11-03 on dense 2-tick FULL dumps with every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4, on c078f6cd and on the merge-base b055ef7f. uid 1 (the player Infantry, pressed by the enemy foot) dips to nnd_min 2.32, 2.18, 2.32, 2.24 and 2.19 wu against its 2.25 wu floor on both trees alike, failing on seeds 1, 3 and 4: press compression in the infantry melee, tracked by #1911. uid 3 (the player's charging cavalry) reads 6.76, 4.96, 6.03, 5.71 and 3.91 wu against its 5.0 wu floor here, failing on seeds 1 and 4 (5.16, 0.76, 3.56, 6.23 and 3.73 on the merge-base): in the charge turnaround mounts about 150 wu off their slots swap sides across each other and pass close as they do, which #1804 tracks. On the clip's own ticks both read STALE (uid 1 17.99 wu, uid 3 6.76 wu), the dense-only case #1821 tracks for this clip.

facing_flutter.reason: Measured on dense 2-tick FULL dumps with every exemption removed, Windows, 2026-11-03, seeds 0 to 4: the cycle-charging cavalry uid 3, marching out of contact between charges, reverses its heading 3, 4, 1, 1 and 2 times in a row on c078f6cd against a threshold of 3, so it fails on seed 1 only; the merge-base b055ef7f reads 3, 3, 1, 1 and 2 and passes on all five. The square casualty close-up moves the clip from tick 988 on every seed (a squared block's casualties now close up its files instead of renumbering the pairing), and that perturbs the caracole; the clip seed itself still passes. Tracked by #1841 (the caracoling cavalry's heading flutter). Uid 4 is no longer exempted: it reads 0, 0, 0, 1 and 0 on the same dumps here, and 1, 0, 0, 1 and 0 on b055ef7f.
